name: deadlands-character-creator-and-tracker
description: Unofficial local-first Deadlands/SWADE character creator and table tracker.

scripts.test:static: node tests/static/parse-js.cjs && node tests/static/lint.cjs && node tests/static/validate-catalogs.cjs
scripts.test:setup: playwright test tests/browser/setup-baseline-source.spec.js tests/browser/setup-core.spec.js tests/browser/setup-edges.spec.js tests/browser/setup-gear.spec.js tests/browser/setup-powers.spec.js
scripts.test:setup:desktop: playwright test --project=desktop tests/browser/setup-baseline-source.spec.js tests/browser/setup-core.spec.js tests/browser/setup-edges.spec.js tests/browser/setup-gear.spec.js tests/browser/setup-powers.spec.js
scripts.test:quick: npm run test:static && npm run test:browser:fast
scripts.test: npm run test:static && npm run test:browser
scripts.format: prettier --write README.md NOTICE.md PRIVACY.md docs/case-study.md docs/character-setup-contract.md docs/advancement-contract.md docs/deadlands-power-points-arcane-backgrounds.md docs/manual-checklist.md docs/mechanics-roadmap.md docs/project-documentation-guide.md index.html package.json playwright.config.cjs "tests/**/*.{js,cjs}" src/config.js src/persistence.js src/app-ui.js src/app.js src/arcane.js src/creator.js src/default-character.js src/savaged-import.js src/tracker.js "src/tracker/**/*.js"
scripts.format:check: prettier --check README.md NOTICE.md PRIVACY.md docs/case-study.md docs/character-setup-contract.md docs/advancement-contract.md docs/deadlands-power-points-arcane-backgrounds.md docs/manual-checklist.md docs/mechanics-roadmap.md docs/project-documentation-guide.md index.html package.json playwright.config.cjs "tests/**/*.{js,cjs}" src/config.js src/persistence.js src/app-ui.js src/app.js src/arcane.js src/creator.js src/default-character.js src/savaged-import.js src/tracker.js "src/tracker/**/*.js"
